title: PHP 8.1. What does this print?
options: An error: strtoupper(...) is not valid
explain: strtoupper(...) is the first-class callable syntax from PHP 8.1. It makes a Closure from the function, without a string name. array_map calls it for every item, so you get ANN,BOB.

title: You changed app.php and created a new file notes.php (never added). You run git stash. What happens to notes.php?
options: It stays in your folder, because stash ignores untracked files by default
It is stashed together with app.php
git stash fails with an error
explain: By default git stash saves only changes to tracked files. A new untracked file stays where it is. Use git stash -u (--include-untracked) to stash it too. Remember that git stash does not touch ignored files unless you add -a.
